scheme.name: Swiss performance-related heavy vehicle fee (LSVA / RPLP)

dataset.method: Schwerverkehrsabgabeverordnung (SVAV, SR 641.811) of 6 March 2000, Art. 14 and Annex 1 as in force in 2024: 3.10 / 2.69 / 2.28 Rappen per tonne-km for fee categories 1 / 2 / 3 until 31 December 2024; EURO 0-V in category 1, EURO VI in category 3; chargeable weight at most 40 t.

sources.title: Federal Council media release attachment (BAV): LSVA tariffs until 31.12.2024 and from 1.1.2025

tax.note: carbon-cost states the tax basis in each table's text (dataset.method), not as a field.

liable_vehicles.description: Motor vehicles and trailers over 3.5 t total weight used for goods transport, Swiss or foreign

network.description: All public roads: the fee is per km driven anywhere in Switzerland and Liechtenstein.

params.note: Motor vehicles with electric drive are exempt.
